name: Wolve Loyalty
author: Wolve AI

sections.description:
Wolve is a loyalty platform plugin designed to help you easily reward your customers through an intuitive loyalty program. Enhance customer engagement and encourage repeat business by providing points, discounts, and exclusive offers.

Features:

  • Create and manage a comprehensive loyalty program
  • Reward points for purchases
  • Create coupons
  • Tiered Programs
  • Referrals
  • Integration with WooCommerce for seamless transactions
  • Track user activities and engagement with detailed reports in Wolve Platform

Short Description

Enhance customer engagement and retention with Wolve Loyalty. Reward shoppers with points, discounts, and exclusive offers. Enjoy seamless WooCommerce integration and in-depth analytics to drive repeat business and growth in sales.

How to Obtain Credentials to Connect Your Store

Reach out to our support and customer service team at post@wolve.ai, and they will provide you with an API key to connect your store.

How do I reward customers with loyalty points?

You can configure reward rules in the Wolve platform to define how many points customers earn based on their purchase total.

Does it integrate with WooCommerce?

Yes, Wolve Loyalty fully integrates with WooCommerce for seamless rewards distribution.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wolve-loyalty= directory, or install via the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Access the plugin settings via the newly created ‘Wolve Loyalty’ menu.
  4. Input the API key provided by our support team to connect your store and start using the loyalty program features.

screenshots.caption: Dashboard - The Wolve Platform Dashboard is a critical component of the plugin, designed to track and analyze customer engagement and loyalty. It offers insights into key performance indicators such as loyalty engagement ratio, new and total membership counts, as well as revenue generated from members. The dashboard provides a detailed breakdown of product rankings, sales performance over time, and a graphical representation of membership trends, aiding in strategic decision-making.

Members - This section provides a comprehensive overview of the member management features of the plugin. It allows users to view all members, add new members manually, or import members in bulk. The dashboard displays vital information such as customer names, contact details, and signup dates. The interface supports sorting and searching capabilities to manage a large number of members efficiently, making it an indispensable tool for businesses looking to enhance their customer relationship management strategies.

Programs - This section of the Wolve Platform provides a robust loyalty program management system that allows users to create, manage, and monitor the effectiveness of their loyalty programs. The dashboard features interactive graphs and statistics that display loyalty program redemption rates. Users can choose between different types of loyalty programs such as stampcard, cashpoint etc. The intuitive interface is designed for easy navigation and efficiency, ensuring a streamlined loyaty program creation process.

APIConfiguration - API settings for the plugin’s operation. Users must enter their unique API key in the designated field and save the settings to integrate the plugin with external services. This ensures secure data exchange and enhances functionality, allowing the plugin to perform optimally with the Wolve platform.

Terms of service - This section provides users with access to the Wolve Platform's legal documents, including the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. These documents outline the rights and responsibilities of users and the platform, ensuring transparency in how data is managed and services are provided. Users can review the full details by following the link provided: Terms of Service.
